action.description: Which action produced this item: scan, batch, yield or radar.

chain.description: The chain the result is about.

symbol.description: Token symbol. Token creators choose it, so don't rely on it alone.

verdict.description: CLEAN, LOW RISK, CAUTION, HIGH RISK, RUG-SHAPED or UNKNOWN.

score.description: Safety score from 0 to 100. Higher is safer.

confidence.description: How much of the check could be read, from 0 to 100.

bottomLine.description: One plain-language sentence on the result.

degraded.description: True when too many data sources were unavailable. Not charged.

error.description: Why this item failed. Not charged.
